gauntlet.intent: T5 main-ladder #4 (capstone): CASCADING ADVERSARIAL INJECTS (primary dimension) at full 3-stage cascade -- 3 staggered jammers (ticks 10/20/30, jamStrength 0.3/0.4/0.5) each paired with a mission.events EventFired marker at the same tick (comms_loss_inject_designated @10, sensor_degradation_inject_designated_2 @20, reinforcement_pressure_inject_designated_2 @30), the heaviest cascade in this batch (scenario-2 and scenario-3 each carry 2-3 staggered stages; this scenario is the corpus's dedicated 3-full-stage exercise). Per the required-mechanism list for this run, all three injects are modeled exclusively via jammers[].activeFromTick (confirmed-working per BUG-scenario-contacts-shadowed-by-detection.md's control check) and mission.events EventFired markers (confirmed-working, pure tick-scheduled) -- contacts[] is not used anywhere in this policy. concurrent_domains_checkpoint @36 closes the run 4 ticks before the 40-tick budget ends, confirming the cascade completed with the multi-domain fight still live. SECONDARY DIMENSION -- MULTI-DOMAIN CONCURRENT CAPSTONE, reinforcing (not duplicating) scenario-1's primary concurrency claim: both sides run WeaponsFree from tick 0 (friendlyRoe=WeaponsFree, opposingRoe=WeaponsFree), with denials driven by a differently-tuned ScenarioContactLifecycle gate (classifyAfterTicks=6/identifyAfterTicks=12, vs scenario-1's 5/10) so the corpus samples a third distinct ID-gate denial envelope (alongside t4's 3/6 and 4/8) at this tier's larger 40-tick budget. ASW thread: ka-27m-helix-a + a-26-blekinge + a-19-gotland-2020 prosecute pl-877-kilo-paltus-1992 / pla-885-severodvinsk-yasen / plarb-955-borei-borey (the roster's flagged SSBN high-value ASW target, same convention as tier 4). AAW thread: eurofighter-typhoon (dual-target) intercepts mig-29-fulcrum-c-1999 and su-27sm-sm3-flanker-j-2013. Strike/intercept thread: f-16c-blk-52iq-falcon-2015 vs mig-31-foxhound. Escort/patrol threads: f-310-fridtjof-nansen vs skr-admiral-sergey-gorshkov-pr-2235-0, p-960-skjold vs mrk-shkval-pr-22800-karakurt. DENSE-RED / ASYMMETRIC JOINT MIX / UNDERUSED-PLATFORM COVERAGE: this scenario deliberately completes this batch's coverage of roster.json's flagged underused-platform set with a-26-blekinge, a-19-gotland-2020, and plarb-955-borei-borey (SSBN HVU) -- none of which appear in scenario-1/-2/-3 -- alongside an 8-unit RED package (3 air + 2 surface + 3 subsurface, including the SSBN) against a 7-unit BLUE package, matching the tier's 'dense red, asymmetric joint mix' spec.
gauntlet.oracle: All four EventFired codes (comms_loss_inject_designated @10, sensor_degradation_inject_designated_2 @20, reinforcement_pressure_inject_designated_2 @30, concurrent_domains_checkpoint @36) must appear in the fingerprint regardless of seed. BLUE (WeaponsFree throughout) is expected to register kills across at least two of the four threads (ASW/AAW/strike/escort-patrol) inside the 40-tick run as ID-gated contacts convert past the 6/12-tick classify/identify gate; denials accrue only from that gate, not ROE, and should be a modest fraction of the run given 40 ticks affords ample time past the 12-tick identify threshold even with the 3-stage jam cascade degrading Pd on three specific trials (c-s4-1, c-s4-4, c-s4-9) from ticks 10/20/30 onward. RED (also WeaponsFree) is expected to convert some of its own detections (c-s4-9, c-s4-10) into kills against BLUE, but only BLUE is scored (expect.side=BLUE).
